podcast.body: Sung by drummer Walter Orange, this funk-ode to "calipage in women" was one of the Commodores' most popular hits, reaching the Top 5 on both the pop and R&B charts, proving the band's continued ability to deliver funk alongside their ballads. "Their very next hit to this day, one of their most popular, sung by drummer Walter Orange, was the funk-old to calipage in women brick house."
